methods.score: R84-R2 max absolute robust-z with R84-R2 scale fallback
methods.conditional_upper_bound: 18 physical contexts; wheel index simultaneously sets known commanded maneuver axis and QA-only fault target, so their separate effects are confounded
methods.target_blind: six initial-attitude/reference groups pooling all three maneuver axes and fault targets; 90 healthy calibration cases per group; axis-blind as well as target-blind
methods.report: exact positive, negative and abstain counts by context and reference; no threshold tuning
